The turn-1 to turn-2 diff is minimal and scoped to the repair, the turn-1 custody paragraph, the disposition row, and three tightening additions to the measured-inputs table and the remeasurement clause; no guardrail was deleted or weakened and no new scope was introduced. Subject sha256 matches at mode 0444, the frozen turn-1 subject is unmoved at 0444, and all thirteen cited digests plus HEAD recompute exactly. Both Stage A occupancy verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 at 0444, as are v1 through v5. Live register recomputes to required-now 28, owners 32 of 32, condition 2 at 4 of 32, DR-G16 status OPEN and assurance stage PROPOSED-not-QUALIFIED, DR-121 OPEN, 32 DR-G rows ending at DR-G32; file 08 and COORD are unmodified in git and COORD carries no D-215 heading. The Reversibility span enumerates D-167 through D-214 complete at 48 identifiers with D-168 present and no gaps, extras, or duplicates. The gate-row abstention sentence is byte-identical to the five adopted sibling drafts and correctly declines to rule on D-056 gates 2 and 3. All seventeen attacks were run; none landed.
